content: REUSABLE METHODOLOGICAL PRINCIPLE surfaced during cannabis 3-system synthesis 2026-05-18. When N independent research systems (here: Grok, Gemini, ChatGPT, plus Harper/Lucas/Benjamin collaborative pass) converge on the same conclusions, convergence FEELS like N-fold independent verification but is only as strong as the weakest SHARED assumption beneath it. In this case all three leaned on the same anchor studies (Cooper 2013, Di Forti 2019 EU-GEI, Santiago 2019/Heblinski 2020, Cochrane 2026). The agreement is substantially shared-source agreement, not triple-independent confirmation. Correct synthesis move: state the shared-source-convergence limitation plainly in the final artifact caveats rather than presenting convergence as strong multi-witness verification. This is the synthesis-layer analogue of the declare-before-verify failure mode: do not declare consensus-strength you have not earned by checking source independence. Carry this into all future multi-system or multi-instance synthesis work.
